name: Baked Lemon Chicken with Asparagus, Kalamata Olive Rice & Warm Tomato Salad (Two Ways)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe was created to feed two adults and two young children. You know your child (their tastes and appetite) best. Use this recipe as a template, adjusting ingredients, cooking methods, and portions as needed.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup jasmine rice
2 cups chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lemon
1 small bunch asparagus
1 pint grape tomatoes
½ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, zest and juice lemon into a medium bowl. Add oil, Dijon, and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Dijon mustard
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp rosemary, dried
½ tsp paprika
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels. Add to the bowl with the marinade and turn to coat. Transfer chicken to one half of a baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless

instructions.primary_message: Snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Add to the other half of the baking sheet, drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, flipping the chicken and stirring the asparagus halfway, until chicken is cooked through and asparagus is tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice shallots lengthwise into thin strips. Transfer to another baking sheet, along with half of the tomatoes. Drizzle with oil and season with spices, then stir to coat and spread out in an even layer. Halve remaining tomatoes, place on a plate, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp oregano, dried
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add baking sheet to the oven and roast until shallots are softened and tomatoes are bursting, 5-7 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Place in a small bowl.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl with the dill.

When the rice is done, uncover and fluff with a fork. Add 1 cup of plain rice to the plate with the halved tomatoes. Add oil, dill, and olives to the pan with the remaining rice. Stir to combine and set aside.
Medium dice half of the feta and add to the plate. Crumble remaining feta onto the baking sheet with the tomatoes, drizzle with balsamic glaze, then stir to combine the warm tomato salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (8 oz) block feta cheese
2 tsp balsamic glaze

instructions.primary_message:
FOR THE KIDS PLATES: Cut 2 chicken thighs and a handful of asparagus into bite-sized pieces, then divide between plates, along with plain rice, halved tomatoes, and diced feta. 

FOR THE ADULT PLATES: Divide olive rice, remaining chicken thighs, asparagus, and warm tomato salad between plates. Enjoy!
